name: @forgeax/demo-gallery
description: Single-port gallery for forgeax-engine Vite demos.

bundle-size.reason: development-only aggregate host; its production bundle duplicates every discovered demo and is not a shipped artifact

fps.reason: gallery embeds independently owned demos; runtime performance belongs to each demo's existing smoke and metric gates

bench.reason: demo discovery is covered by deterministic contract tests and has no stable micro-benchmark surface

gate.reason: development-only host is intentionally outside application build shards; discovery tests and representative browser probes validate it
